Usage: srv db <command> [options]

Manage the database.

Commands:
  migrate  Migrate the database to the current schema.
  seed     Load the fixtures into the database.

Options:
  -d, --dsn string  Data source name of the database.  env SRV_DB_DSN, key db.dsn

Global options:
  -c, --config file  Config file in JSON or INI.                                             env SRV_CONFIG
      --flag-debug   Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env SRV_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help         Show the help.
  -v, --verbose      Log more.                                                               env SRV_VERBOSE, key verbose
